ratings_why.fun: Tying in other tribes' best units and skimming their gains with Gossip is a fun draft puzzle, but much of the growth is plain End of Turn +1/+1 buffers.
ratings_why.distinct: 8 over 7: no tribe splits each hit across a tangled body, so Shield, Damage Reduction and 'takes damage' fire per share and the back row soaks from the first hit; that is the knot itself on the board, not a reskinned buffer tribe.

verdict_why: Two reading gaps need a fix: which units are Tied to begin with, and how the split's leftover and zero shares work.

points.text: No rat card says Tied, yet the rationale says every rat splits damage and the Piper says 'can't be Tied'. State it on the cards or as a tribe rule ('Rats are Tied'), or a player can't tell which units are in a Knot.

Say whether the unit hit takes its own share plus the leftover, and whether a 0 share counts as taking damage. That decides when Old Gundel, Ticklish Chirper and Shield popping fire on small hits and on Mill-Chimney Sweep's pokes.
Supper Sniffer's six-keyword list is hard to read at a glance; 'copies its neighbours' keywords' with the list in the keyword glossary would read faster and fits sniffing a nestmate's breath.

Nestmate Groomer, Bell-Ringer, Cheese-Rind Keeper and Speaker Brotkrume are all End of Turn buffs; give one a council twist, such as a vote between two buffs, so procedure shows in play, not only in names.
The Piper is the best flavour-in-mechanics card here; the fight screen should show the reading-order volley clearly, since its puzzle is order.

standouts.why: The one tune that leads the knot away, made into a real choice: grow tied, fight loose.
Tying the enemy is a fresh, readable trick that uses the next opponent's visible board.
One shared Health pool is the Rat King legend in a single line: none dies until all do.

weakest.why: Little Fips is a plain Attack-per-ally body with no late role and nothing of 'the one who sees ahead'.
Nestmate Groomer is a generic End of Turn buffer; grooming could do something only a knot can.
Loyal Cagemate is a stock 'summon tokens on death'; freeing the stuck is a theme it doesn't use.

flags.note: With The King Enthroned's copied Health and Old Gundel's Attack, the shared pool could run away inside a fight.
Golden Ilse makes Gossip take all of the knot's gains; with a tied Ooze Eat that could run away.
'Of units next to it (highest N)': unclear if it copies from each neighbour of each knot unit or only Sniffer's own neighbours.
